🎥🎬: Bear Just Wanted to Play 🐻😂

A man casually stands beside the road, completely focused on his phone call, unaware that a curious bear has wandered right up behind him. Instead of attacking, the bear starts playfully messing with the man’s calves while he somehow remains completely distracted by the conversation.

The hilarious moment becomes even funnier as the bear continues trying to get his attention, while the man acts like absolutely nothing unusual is happening. It’s the kind of situation where everyone watching notices the problem except the one person who probably should.

Sometimes you’re so locked into a phone call that even a bear can’t get your attention. 😂
